hints.en: `sum(scores)` gives the total and `len(scores)` the number of records.

hints.tr: Ortalama ikisinin bölümü: `sum(scores) / len(scores)`. Bölme her zaman ondalık sayı döndürüyor.
hints.en: The average is one divided by the other: `sum(scores) / len(scores)`. Division always returns a decimal number.

hints.tr: Yazdırırken virgülden sonra bir basamak istiyoruz: `print(round(average, 1))`.
hints.en: When printing we want one digit after the point: `print(round(average, 1))`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
scores = [72, 85, 90, 64, 78]

average = sum(scores) / len(scores)

print(round(average, 1))
```
